parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records is `MockDeviceContext` located at `Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/Mocks/MockDeviceContext.swift`, which is a test-fixture mock of the production `DeviceContext` type at `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Throttling/DeviceContext.swift`. The mock's structural similarity to the production type is intentional and load-bearing: it exists precisely to mirror the production interface for test isolation. Lifting shared structure between a mock and its production counterpart would couple production semantics to test infrastructure. No refactor is warranted.
